newsitem.title: USA: No assurance FTC to approve merger - Staples.
newsitem.headline: No assurance FTC to approve merger - Staples.

text.p: Staples Inc CEO Tom Stemberg said Wednesday there is no assurance the Federal Trade Commission will approve a merger deal involving the divestiture of 63 Office Depot and Staples stores.
Earlier in the day, OfficeMax Inc announced it had agreed to buy those stores for about $108 million.
"We can give no assurances that the commisioners will approve this package," he said told reporters in a conference telephone call from New York.
Stemberg said that if the deal goes through nearly 40 stores -- 15 in the United States and 20 in Canada -- would be closed.
Stemberg also said that the terms of the stock-for-stock agreement would remain the same.
